turns.text: Hi, I need to change the delivery address. The parcel should not go to the address I used at checkout.

Hi, I can help with a delivery address change. Please send me your order number (it looks like SC-1234) and the email address you used when you placed the order. Then I can check the order and the change for you.
The order is SC-3360, the email is nora.blake@example.com, and the new address is Str. Exemplu 22, Sibiu.

Thank you, Nora. I checked order SC-3360, and it has already shipped. Our policy allows an address change only until the order ships, so I can't change the delivery address for this order. You can follow the parcel with the tracking link: https://curier.example/track/SC3360. If you need help with the delivery, reply here and I can tell you more about the options.

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.

turns.text: That new address is the one I need used.

I understand this is important to you, Nora. Unfortunately, I can't change the address on SC-3360 because the order has already shipped, and the policy doesn't allow changes after shipping. The parcel is on its way, so you can follow it with the tracking link: https://curier.example/track/SC3360. If you'd like, I can pass your request to a colleague who can look at what's possible with the courier.
